name: Kayo / off-chain power bonus does not turn a five-power defender into a Phantasm popper
printed_text:
You have 1 weapon zone.

Attack action cards you own get +1{p} while they are in any zone other than the combat chain.

The first time you discard a card with 6 or more {p} during each of your action phases, create a Might token.
format_scope: Four manual young Prism1/Kayo2/Dori3/4 at20. ActualPotion8/ABI10 funds2; actualHeraldProtection9 power7 declaresHero2 and pays2/AP1. RealRagingOnslaughtBlue5 base5 andWounds6/7 base4 defendfromHand onCombatChain. Kayo only grants+1 outsideCombatChain, so realRagingBlue defender must not become a six-power Phantasm popper. Wounds also remain below6. Physicaldefense3+3+3=9 fullyblocks7; actual0damage/allhealth20, noPhantasm orHeraldHit layers. FullClose sendsactualHerald9/Potion8 toGY1 anddefenders5/6/7toGY2, noMight/Discardevent. This is a limited observable CombatChain-zone exclusion for the Phantasm decision, not certification of Hand power APIs, Rouse237, positive Might or wholeHero. No source repairs.
